Title: November 2015 updates to Azure Mobile Apps

Body.Content:
We've released a number of updates to Azure Mobile Apps, including updated Node.js, .NET server SDKs, and updated client SDKs. This set of updates includes:
  • Authentication improvements
  • REST API updates
  • A preview of in-portal editing
These are captured in today's portal updates and in the following SDK releases:
  • Node.js Server SDK - 2.0.0-alpha5
  • .NET Server SDK - 0.3.36.0 (Release Candidate)
  • iOS client SDK - 3.0.0-beta4 (Release Candidate)
  • Windows and Xamarin client SDK - 2.0.0-beta3 (Release candidate)
To learn more, see our blog post Azure Mobile Apps November 2015 Update.
